갈라디아서 1:1.content: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)

갈라디아서 1:2.content: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:

갈라디아서 1:3.content: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,

갈라디아서 1:4.content: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:

갈라디아서 1:5.content: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

갈라디아서 1:6.content: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:

갈라디아서 1:7.content: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.

갈라디아서 1:8.content: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.

갈라디아서 1:9.content: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.

갈라디아서 1:10.content: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.

갈라디아서 1:11.content: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.

갈라디아서 1:12.content: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.

갈라디아서 1:13.content: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:

갈라디아서 1:14.content: And profited in the Jews’ religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.

갈라디아서 1:15.content: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother’s womb, and called me by his grace,

갈라디아서 1:16.content: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:

갈라디아서 1:17.content: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.

갈라디아서 1:18.content: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.

갈라디아서 1:19.content: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord’s brother.

갈라디아서 1:20.content: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.

갈라디아서 1:21.content: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;

갈라디아서 1:22.content: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judea which were in Christ:

갈라디아서 1:23.content: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.

갈라디아서 1:24.content: And they glorified God in me.
